items.verification: The v0.6.0 catalog now returns exactly the two official products even when the production snapshot still contains the retired ROOT_PREBIOTIC_7D_RESET item. Dynamic image and price fields remain overridable; appId and product paths remain authoritative.

items.overridePolicy: An explicit persisted sessionPopup configuration, including PENDING or disabled content, takes precedence and prevents the code fallback from bypassing an operator decision.

items.reason: The exact approved questionnaire, generic scoring rules, dimensions and result-copy mapping for the new v0.6.0 assessment Interface are not available in the repository or accessible source material. Existing tests use fixtures explicitly labeled as non-formal.
items.safetyBehavior: The runtime remains fail-closed and does not expose an assessment whose content, professional and compliance review statuses are not all APPROVED.

items.reason: Ardot provides flow and example copy but is not the authoritative professional/compliance publication record. No approval metadata is invented.
items.note: The product decision that this review item is not a release blocker is preserved; this file only records that the runtime definition cannot be fabricated.
